svg.title: Save room: Mario coding at his desk at night
svg.desc: Pixel-art bedroom at night. Mario sits on a mushroom stool typing; the monitor reads: > whoami / piyush · vit pune / > status / backend ai @ flyrank / > git push / ★ level clear!. Fairy lights blink, the mushroom lamp sways, steam rises from a 1UP mug and a potted piranha plant chomps.
